split_pattern.cv_recommendation: Time-series / group-time split: train periods (77 monthly period_ids, 2019-01 through 2025-06 minus the 6 prediction periods) and prediction periods (6 monthly period_ids in sample_submission, drawn from 2025-2026 range) are disjoint with no overlap. Use chronological holdout (e.g. last N periods of train as validation folds) grouped by jurisdiction/category, blocked on period_id (block_mae). val/covariates.csv contains one extra period_id (dsZhPyK4) not present in sample_submission.csv -- treat as buffer/context only, not a prediction target.
split_pattern.category_decomposition_note: train/dose_sys_train.csv contains 8 overdose_category values (all_drugs, all_opioids, all_stimulants, heroin, fentanyl, cocaine, methamphetamine, benzodiazepine) per (period_id, jurisdiction) in long format -- not separate columns, so they are not 'sub_target_candidates' columns. Only all_drugs, all_opioids, all_stimulants are scored (per sample_submission). The other 5 categories are highly correlated (corr 0.70-0.88 with the 3 scoring categories, except heroin which is weakly correlated ~0.18 / -0.10) and may be used as leakage-safe auxiliary training signal/features (e.g. via cross-category aggregates fit per fold) but categories are nested and non-exclusive -- never sum across categories.

warnings: evaluation_metric not explicitly named in Data_Description.md; inferred 'block_mae' (block=period_id) as the standard metric for this panel-regression task per orchestrator-supplied hint and standard practice for this benchmark series.
val/covariates.csv contains period_id 'dsZhPyK4' (2025-06-30) which does not appear in sample_submission.csv (6 periods only) -- it is extra context/buffer data, not a row to predict.

train/dose_sys_train.csv contains 8 overdose_category values but sample_submission.csv only requires 3 (all_drugs, all_opioids, all_stimulants); categories are nested/non-exclusive and must never be summed.

prediction_file set to data/val/covariates.csv (covariates-only, no target) since there is no separate 'prediction' file containing the target column; sample_submission.csv supplies the (row_id, period_id, jurisdiction, overdose_category) keys to predict.
